user.title: Set up Jinja Files
user.description: Adds the jinja_files.render service. No configuration needed — drop .j2 files under the templates/ directory and call the service.

render.name: Render templates
render.description: Render every .j2 file under the templates/ directory to its corresponding location.

path.name: Template path
path.description: Optional single template path, relative to the templates/ directory.

override.name: Override existing files
override.description: Overwrite output files that already exist. Disabled by default — existing files are skipped.
